newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar remains steady through slow day.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar remains steady through slow day.

text.p: White sugar prices held steady throughout a slow trading day and at the close were $0.20 down to $0.20 a tonne up.
The two-day Thanksgiving holiday closure of the New York raw sugar market was blamed for the lack of action which is expected to continue through tomorrow, traders said.

Slightly higher beet crop updates from Russia and France failed to budge prices and the only physical news was Syria's purchase of a cargo of raws at $292.75 and the cancellation of its whites tender.
Turnover totalled 420 lots after 280 lots were posted against actuals just before the close.
Paris white sugar last traded for March at $303.50, down $0.40 a tonne from Wednesday.
